<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the molecule likely contains a carbonyl carbon at 166 ppm (ester), six aromatic carbons around 129–132 ppm, a methoxy carbon at ~52 ppm, and two aliphatic carbons at ~44 and ~39 ppm. This fits a methyl 3‑phenylpropanoate (methyl phenylpropionate) structure: O=C(OCH₃)CH₂CH₂Ph. The corresponding SMILES is **COOC(=O)CCc1ccccc1**.</thought>
<final_answer>COOC(=O)CCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
